title: spec: declare warnings and droppedFields on ExecutionStepLogSchema (run history serves both undeclared)
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

Filing category: ③ follow-up a review names (contract review of PR #33007, record 6843734657, nit N2).

## Problem

A flow step's log entry carries `warnings` (since #3407) and, after PR #33007, `droppedFields`. Run history persists the step log and serves it verbatim from `GET /api/v1/automation/:name/runs/:runId` and the runs list. `ExecutionStepLogSchema` (`packages/spec/src/automation/execution.zod.ts`) declares neither member, so the published wire carries two members its schema does not name.

## Expected

Either declare both members on `ExecutionStepLogSchema` (optional; `warnings` as strings, `droppedFields` as the existing `DroppedFieldsEventSchema` array), or project them out of the served step log. The spec lane chooses; declaring is a widening (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`), projecting out is a narrowing.

Reader: `domain:spec`.
Suggested-grade: p3 (drift, no caller refused).
